26: // STF is a struct that manages the state transition component of the app.
27: type STF[T transaction.Tx] struct {
28: 	logger log.Logger
29: 
30: 	msgRouter   coreRouterImpl
31: 	queryRouter coreRouterImpl

33: 	doPreBlock        func(ctx context.Context, txs []T) error

36: 	doValidatorUpdate func(ctx context.Context) ([]appmodulev2.ValidatorUpdate, error)

39: 	postTxExec     func(ctx context.Context, tx T, success bool) error
40: 
41: 	branchFn            branchFn // branchFn is a function that given a readonly state it returns a writable version of it.
42: 	makeGasMeter        makeGasMeterFn
43: 	makeGasMeteredState makeGasMeteredStateFn

46: // NewSTF returns a new STF instance.
47: func NewSTF[T transaction.Tx](
48: 	logger log.Logger,
49: 	msgRouterBuilder *MsgRouterBuilder,
50: 	queryRouterBuilder *MsgRouterBuilder,
51: 	doPreBlock func(ctx context.Context, txs []T) error,
52: 	doBeginBlock func(ctx context.Context) error,
53: 	doEndBlock func(ctx context.Context) error,
54: 	doTxValidation func(ctx context.Context, tx T) error,
55: 	doValidatorUpdate func(ctx context.Context) ([]appmodulev2.ValidatorUpdate, error),
56: 	postTxExec func(ctx context.Context, tx T, success bool) error,
57: 	branch func(store store.ReaderMap) store.WriterMap,
58: ) (*STF[T], error) {
59: 	msgRouter, err := msgRouterBuilder.Build()
60: 	if err != nil {
61: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("build msg router: %w", err)
62: 	}
63: 	queryRouter, err := queryRouterBuilder.Build()
64: 	if err != nil {
65: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("build query router: %w", err)
66: 	}
67: 
68: 	return &STF[T]{
69: 		logger:              logger,
70: 		msgRouter:           msgRouter,
71: 		queryRouter:         queryRouter,
72: 		doPreBlock:          doPreBlock,
73: 		doBeginBlock:        doBeginBlock,
74: 		doEndBlock:          doEndBlock,
75: 		doValidatorUpdate:   doValidatorUpdate,
76: 		doTxValidation:      doTxValidation,
77: 		postTxExec:          postTxExec, // TODO
78: 		branchFn:            branch,
79: 		makeGasMeter:        stfgas.DefaultGasMeter,
80: 		makeGasMeteredState: stfgas.DefaultWrapWithGasMeter,
81: 	}, nil

84: // DeliverBlock is our state transition function.
85: // It takes a read only view of the state to apply the block to,
86: // executes the block and returns the block results and the new state.
87: func (s STF[T]) DeliverBlock(
88: 	ctx context.Context,
89: 	block *server.BlockRequest[T],
90: 	state store.ReaderMap,
91: ) (blockResult *server.BlockResponse, newState store.WriterMap, err error) {
92: 	// creates a new branchFn state, from the readonly view of the state
93: 	// that can be written to.
94: 	newState = s.branchFn(state)
95: 	hi := header.Info{
96: 		Hash:    block.Hash,
97: 		AppHash: block.AppHash,
98: 		ChainID: block.ChainId,
99: 		Time:    block.Time,
100: 		Height:  int64(block.Height),
101: 	}
102: 	// set header info
103: 	err = s.setHeaderInfo(newState, hi)
104: 	if err != nil {
105: 		return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("unable to set initial header info, %w", err)
106: 	}
107: 
108: 	exCtx := s.makeContext(ctx, ConsensusIdentity, newState, internal.ExecModeFinalize)
109: 	exCtx.setHeaderInfo(hi)
110: 
111: 	// reset events
112: 	exCtx.events = make([]event.Event, 0)
113: 	// pre block is called separate from begin block in order to prepopulate state
114: 	preBlockEvents, err := s.preBlock(exCtx, block.Txs)
115: 	if err != nil {
116: 		return nil, nil, err
117: 	}
118: 
119: 	if err = isCtxCancelled(ctx); err != nil {
120: 		return nil, nil, err
121: 	}
122: 
123: 	// reset events
124: 	exCtx.events = make([]event.Event, 0)
125: 
126: 	// begin block
127: 	var beginBlockEvents []event.Event
128: 	if !block.IsGenesis {
129: 		// begin block
130: 		beginBlockEvents, err = s.beginBlock(exCtx)
131: 		if err != nil {
132: 			return nil, nil, err
133: 		}
134: 	}
135: 
136: 	// check if we need to return early
137: 	if err = isCtxCancelled(ctx); err != nil {
138: 		return nil, nil, err
139: 	}
140: 
141: 	// execute txs
142: 	txResults := make([]server.TxResult, len(block.Txs))
143: 	// TODO: skip first tx if vote extensions are enabled (marko)
144: 	for i, txBytes := range block.Txs {
145: 		// check if we need to return early or continue delivering txs
146: 		if err = isCtxCancelled(ctx); err != nil {
147: 			return nil, nil, err
148: 		}
149: 		txResults[i] = s.deliverTx(exCtx, newState, txBytes, transaction.ExecModeFinalize, hi)
150: 	}
151: 	// reset events
152: 	exCtx.events = make([]event.Event, 0)
153: 	// end block
154: 	endBlockEvents, valset, err := s.endBlock(exCtx)
155: 	if err != nil {
156: 		return nil, nil, err
157: 	}
158: 
159: 	return &server.BlockResponse{
160: 		ValidatorUpdates: valset,
161: 		PreBlockEvents:   preBlockEvents,
162: 		BeginBlockEvents: beginBlockEvents,
163: 		TxResults:        txResults,
164: 		EndBlockEvents:   endBlockEvents,
165: 	}, newState, nil
166: }

168: // deliverTx executes a TX and returns the result.
169: func (s STF[T]) deliverTx(
170: 	ctx context.Context,
171: 	state store.WriterMap,
172: 	tx T,
173: 	execMode transaction.ExecMode,
174: 	hi header.Info,
175: ) server.TxResult {
176: 	// recover in the case of a panic
177: 	var recoveryError error
178: 	defer func() {
179: 		if r := recover(); r != nil {
180: 			recoveryError = fmt.Errorf("panic during transaction execution: %s", r)
181: 			s.logger.Error("panic during transaction execution", "error", recoveryError)
182: 		}
183: 	}()
184: 	// handle error from GetGasLimit
185: 	gasLimit, gasLimitErr := tx.GetGasLimit()
186: 	if gasLimitErr != nil {
187: 		return server.TxResult{
188: 			Error: gasLimitErr,
189: 		}
190: 	}
191: 
192: 	if recoveryError != nil {
193: 		return server.TxResult{
194: 			Error: recoveryError,
195: 		}
196: 	}
197: 
198: 	validateGas, validationEvents, err := s.validateTx(ctx, state, gasLimit, tx, execMode)
199: 	if err != nil {
200: 		return server.TxResult{
201: 			Error: err,
202: 		}
203: 	}
204: 
205: 	execResp, execGas, execEvents, err := s.execTx(ctx, state, gasLimit-validateGas, tx, execMode, hi)
206: 	return server.TxResult{
207: 		Events:    append(validationEvents, execEvents...),
208: 		GasUsed:   execGas + validateGas,
209: 		GasWanted: gasLimit,
210: 		Resp:      execResp,
211: 		Error:     err,
212: 	}
213: }
